title: Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars - Fight Against Smithy, Who Likes Transforming (Edited)
description:
Background from the final battle.

Before I get into anything else, let me advise that this uses 5 graphic files (albeit 1 is only about half used which is the one assigned to FG2.) Because of this and the fact that it's normally a 1-screen background, I'd say it's basically only usable for a 1-screen boss fight by using invisible blocks as the floor or maybe as a cutscene background.

This has been edited to only use 1 palette row, default row 3. Includes the alternate palette as well for when Smithy is defeated.
